turns.q: How do I find my tracking link?
turns.replyTail:
find your tracking link in the shipping confirmation email sent after your order is dispatched. 
Once the courier collects your package, a tracking link is emailed to you.
Open that email and click the tracking link to view real‑time delivery updates.
If you haven’t received it yet, it usually means the order is still being processed and hasn’t shipped yet.
